text.p: Tropical Depression Dolores has 35 mph winds and is about 1050 miles east of Hawaii, moving west at 12 mph. It is expected to dissipate well east of Hawaii in about 24 hours. It is only a minor threat to shipping at this time.

A low pressure system between Bermuda and the Bahamas' is being watched as it may develop to a tropical storm during the next day or two. It is expected to move north and then northeast so it should not affect the USA mainland. It may, however, have some minor impact on shipping and boating in the Atlantic.
There are no further statements at this time.
